text.description: For USER_STATED only: exact unchanged substring of the CURRENT user message, not a paraphrase or interpretation. For paraphrases choose MODEL_DERIVED_SUMMARY.
text.title: Text

provenance.description: HYPOTHESIS kind requires MODEL_HYPOTHESIS; all other kinds cannot use MODEL_HYPOTHESIS. USER_STATED requires an exact current-user quote and OBSERVATION/FEELING/ACTION kind. Prefer MODEL_DERIVED_SUMMARY for every paraphrase. Never USER_CONFIRMED.
provenance.title: Provenance

source_refs.description: Exact supplied sNN aliases only. USER_STATED must cite only current_message_ref; historical roles may be unknown. Other items cite their actual supporting supplied context.
